opportunity.label: The New Scenario of Executive Advisory
opportunity.lead: The market has changed. Clients expect much more than reports.
opportunity.p1: For years, consultants were hired to deliver diagnostics. Today, organizations expect partners capable of monitoring decisions, anticipating risks, and continuously contributing to value generation.
opportunity.p2: This is the greatest opportunity for professionals who want to go beyond one-off projects and establish themselves as long-term strategic partners.

positioning.label: Evolution
positioning.lead: You stop competing on hours worked and start competing on governance.

authority.label: Strengthen your professional authority

paths.label: Two Paths

model1.title: Illumine Certified Advisor Network™

model2.title: Illumine Platform Partner™
